history_origin.title: Origins of Saju: The Dawn of Sui-Tang Era
history_origin.description: Saju began with Li Shizhen of the Tang Dynasty, who initially focused on the birth year. Later, Xu Ziping of the Song Dynasty introduced a revolutionary shift by centering the analysis on the birth day (Day Master), completing what is now known as "Ziping Mingli." It is a philosophical system that views humans as independent universes, exploring how the energetic composition at the moment of birth influences one's life path.
history_origin.summary: Saju is not mere superstition, but an ancient Eastern temporal statistics accumulated over 1,400 years.

mechanism_pillars.title: The Four Pillars and Eight Characters
mechanism_pillars.description: Saju (Four Pillars) represents the Year, Month, Day, and Hour of birth. Each pillar consists of two characters: a Heavenly Stem and an Earthly Branch, totaling Eight Characters (Bazi). Heavenly Stems symbolize spiritual goals and outward energy, while Earthly Branches represent the realistic foundation and internal potential. The distribution and interaction of the Five Elements (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) within these characters determine the core of one's personality and destiny.
mechanism_pillars.summary: Eight characters distributed across four pillars (Year, Month, Day, Hour) form your energy map.

advanced_interaction.title: Hap and Chung: Harmony and Conflict
advanced_interaction.description: The highlight of Saju lies in Hap (Combination) and Chung (Clash). Hap refers to the process where different energies meet to create new energy or find stability, while Chung refers to the process where strong energies collide to create change and dynamism. For example, Liu-Hap (Six Combinations) suggests close cooperation, while Chung implies innovation that breaks existing frameworks or movement. Reading these complex dynamics is the essence of true Saju analysis.
advanced_interaction.summary: Destiny moves not by a simple list of characters, but by the organic attraction and repulsion between them.

global_logic.title: Global Saju: The Art of Latitude and Longitude
global_logic.description: While traditional Saju was established based on Eastern standard time, the essence of energy lies in the relative position of the Sun and Earth (Local Solar Time). Therefore, when analyzing Saju for someone born in New York or Paris, one must first calculate the True Solar Time based on that location's longitude. Additionally, for those born in the Southern Hemisphere, there are modern theories emphasizing the adjustment of Month Branch interpretations due to reversed seasons. OIYO preciseley corrects and analyzes such global data.
global_logic.summary: Energy knows no borders. Explaining precise time correction for international births.

critique_modern.title: Critique and Insight: From Superstition to Existential Tool
critique_modern.description: From a modern scientific perspective, aspects of Saju remain difficult to prove. However, accepting it as a "predetermined destiny" is a misunderstanding of its essence. True Saju analysis is a "life strategy guide" that objectively recognizes one's birth environment and temperament (Seed) and designs the best life through acquired effort. From Carl Jung's perspective of analytical psychology, Saju can be interpreted as a sophisticated symbolic system projecting archetypal images of the human collective unconscious onto the flow of time.
critique_modern.summary: On using Saju as a mirror for self-understanding, rather than a deterministic prison.

biorhythm_pulse.title: The Pulse of the Microcosm: Biorhythm & Saju Resonance
biorhythm_pulse.description: Biorhythm predicts human states through three cycles: Physical (23 days), Emotional (28 days), and Intellectual (33 days). OIYO combines this modern biological theory with Saju's Five Elements to provide a unique "Alchemical Synthesis." The physical cycle corresponds to Wood and Metal, the emotional to Fire and Water, and the intellectual to Earth energy. This allows a multidimensional understanding of how your soul and body resonate with the universal rhythm.
biorhythm_pulse.summary: If Saju is the macro flow of destiny, Biorhythm is the micro pulse of your biology.
